result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Australia, my recommendation would be **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on transaction fees, ease of setup, customer checkout experience and how well it integrates with your store.

## My top 4 payment processors

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Australian domestic cards: 1.7% + \$0.30
- No monthly fee
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and major cards
- Excellent integrations and automation

Best for independent online stores and businesses planning to grow.

Source: [Stripe Australia pricing](https://stripe.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Basic plan standard online cards: 1.75% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate payment gateway required
- Simplifies refunds and order management

Best if your website runs on Shopify.

Source: [Shopify Australia pricing](https://www.shopify.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Online payments: 2.2%
- No monthly fee on Free plan
- Excellent inventory and sales management
- Great integration between online and physical sales

Best if you also sell at markets, shops or events.

Source: [Square Australia pricing](https://squareup.com/au/en/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many customers
- Easy checkout integration
- Supports PayPal balances and eligible card payments
- Can be useful as an additional checkout option

Best as an additional payment method rather than necessarily your primary processor.

Source: [Australian payment gateway comparison](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What would the fees look like?

For illustration, here's what processing a \$100 Australian domestic card payment would cost\:

| Processor | Approx. fee |
|--------|--------|
| Stripe | \$2.00 |
| Shopify Payments (Basic) | \$2.05 |
| Square | \$2.20 |


These are indicative standard rates, not including any other platform or subscription fees.

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store today\:

- **Standalone website\:** Stripe.
- **Shopify website\:** Shopify Payments.
- **Online and physical retail\:** Square.
- **Want another familiar checkout option\:** Add PayPal.
